title: Customer Success Associate
description_text:
Voltus represents the potential of us to better manage energy through simple, cost and risk-free demand response programs. Our commercial and industrial customers earn cash by letting us maximize the value of their operational flexibility in energy markets. We hire people who are bright, gritty, and good, who care about a cleaner energy future, and who want to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. The Role As a Customer Success Associate, you get new customer sites into the energy market and ready to perform so they start earning. You own the project management of onboarding from signed contract to a live site, which means keeping data collection, registrations, hardware installation, and testing moving across Sales, Field Engineering, Market Operations, and Dispatch Operations.
